SEARCH
Package arcade.potts.env.location

Interface Location2D

All Known Implementing Classes:
PottsLocation2D, PottsLocations2D
public interface Location2D
Static location methods for 2D.

Interface defines generalized 2D voxel methods that can be applied for both PottsLocation objects (without regions) and PottsLocations objects (with regions).

      static int calculateHeight(ArrayList<Voxel> voxels)
